sources.snippet: DeepLabV3-Plus-MobileNet Deep Convolutional Neural Network model for semantic segmentation. DeepLabV3 is designed for semantic segmentation at multiple scales, trained on the various datasets. It uses MobileNet as a backbone.

sources.title: Deeplabv3 - PyTorch
sources.snippet: Deeplabv3-MobileNetV3-Large is constructed by a Deeplabv3 model using the MobileNetV3 large backbone. The pre-trained model has been trained on a subset of COCO train2017, on the 20 categories that are present in the Pascal VOC dataset.
